terms.comment: Morgan–Owens’s name, “soy curd”, written with the house’s soja (see “soy”). Classically coāgulum is rennet, and then the curd it makes (Plin. NH 28.162; Lewis & Short).

phrases.latin: Coāgulum sojae in frusta secābō et frīgam.
phrases.english: I’ll cut the tofu into pieces and fry it.

phrases.latin: Coāgulum sojae per sē nihil ferē sapit; jūs eī sapōrem dat.
phrases.english: Tofu tastes of almost nothing by itself; the sauce gives it its flavour.

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. legume: soy: tofu.
